correctness.rationale: For every \(n\ge3\), the partial derivatives are successive coordinate squares, so \(X_n\) is smooth. Substitution gives \(F_n(\gamma_n(x))=F_n(x)^2\). A projectively fixed vector has no zero coordinates and admits a unique scalar representative \(\gamma_n(y)=y\), yielding \(y_i=t^{2^i}\) with \(t\in\mathbb F_{2^n}^{\times}\). The hypersurface equation becomes \(\operatorname{Tr}_n(t)^4=0\), equivalent to \(\operatorname{Tr}_n(t)=0\). The derivative of the Gauss map is zero and its graph meets the diagonal transversely, so the ambient fixed scheme and its closed subscheme on the hypersurface are finite étale. The trace polynomial has derivative one and its nonzero-root factor has degree \(2^{n-1}-1\), establishing the scheme isomorphism. Subfield intersections give every extension count and Möbius inversion the Euler factors. The embedded verifier checks the Gauss identities for \(3\le n\le10\), the three irreducible quintics for \(n=5\), all 15 trace-zero fixed points, and three degree-five orbits over \(\mathbb F_{32}\). Finite tests corroborate, but do not replace, the all-dimension proof.

originality.rationale: The claimed novelty is confined to the full trace-zero Gauss fixed scheme and its Frobenius-orbit/arithmetic classification under the natural ordered-coordinate marking. González-Aguilera–Liendo already give the cyclic Klein cubic equation. Kadyrsizova et al. already cover general self-duality and inseparability of Frobenius-form Gauss maps. Furukawa already characterizes characteristic-two Fermat-type Gauss-rank-zero cubics. These broader and nearest results are explicitly excluded as the claimed contribution and do not state the scheme/the uniform extension point counts in inspected text. value.rationale: The fixed scheme is a canonical arithmetic invariant after choosing the natural equation-defined identification of points and tangent hyperplanes for a smooth, distinguished cyclic cubic. It identifies the unexpectedly etale transverse fixed locus of a globally purely inseparable Gauss endomorphism and gives its exact closed-point spectrum for every dimension and extension. The Klein cubic threefold case has three degree-five points and no rational fixed points, a natural nontrivial descent phenomenon not implied by just knowing inseparability or smooth duality. This is a complete structural classification rather than a narrow arbitrary numerical slice; it supplies a reproducible template for studying marked Gauss dynamics on other Frobenius forms.
